market_question: Will "Iceman" - Drake debut week album sales be less than 300k?
reasoning: Drake's last five solo studio albums show first-week sales ranging from 204k (Honestly, Nevermind) to 732k (Scorpion), with 204k falling under 300k. Thus, historical data suggests roughly a 15-20% chance, not the 1.1% implied by the market. While 'Iceman' is far out and specifics are unknown, the current price dramatically undervalues the possibility of sub-300k sales.
evidence_points: Honestly, Nevermind (2022) debuted with 204k, well under 300k.
For All the Dogs (2023) did 402k, close to the 300k threshold with a decline from previous highs.
Long forecast horizon until summer 2026 introduces high uncertainty, making extreme confidence in >300k unwarranted.
